subject: Is there any different between AFLP data format and ISSR data format for poppy package analysis?

messages.author: de0c0bdae2b57d6e
messages.subject: Is there any different between AFLP data format and ISSR data format for poppy package analysis?
parts:
Dear All

Many data set are available in popper, i.e. AFLP(Aeut), SSR(monpop), SNP(H3N2), GBS; however, there is no data set for ISSR.

ISSR data is a binary character matrix ( 1= present, 0= absent) like as AFLP but I'm not sure that the data format of ISSR is same to that of AFLP.

Is there any different between AFLP data format and ISSR data format for poppy package analysis?

best wishes,

H.T. KIM

messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Is there any different between AFLP data format and ISSR data format for poppy package analysis?

Hi,

If your data are presence/absence data, then they are treated no differently than AFLP data

Best,
Zhian
